page_title: WOL 1-1 SUN | Wolves v Sunderland 02/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.

90+4' What a save from Daniel Bentley! Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90+3' Substitution. Tom Edozie (Wolves) has come on for Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare.
90+2' That's a clear yellow card. Robin Roefs (Sunderland) goes into the book.
90+2' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Mateus Mane (Wolves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.

87' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) finds himself some space inside the penalty box and immediately unleashes a first-time effort. The shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
86' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
83' Andre (Wolves) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
83' The ball is out of play and Wolves manage to earn a corner.
82' Robin Roefs makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Adam Armstrong (Wolves) after a cross from the side.
82' Angel Gomes (Wolves) will take the free kick.
81' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Dennis Cirkin (Sunderland) for his blatant foul.
79' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 16:8.
78' Angel Gomes (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Bueno.
74' Ooh that was close! Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
72' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) replacing Brian Brobbey.
72' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Reinildo Mandava and he is replaced by Dennis Cirkin (Sunderland).
72' Substitution. Noah Sadiki makes way for Habib Diarra (Sunderland).
71' Excellent touch by Yerson Mosquera (Wolves)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.

71' Mateus Mane (Wolves) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Robin Roefs has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
70' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is penalised for holding. Paul Tierney signals a set piece.
68' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is about to take a corner kick.

67' Trai Hume (Sunderland) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sunderland.
67' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
64' The game is interrupted. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
62' Mateus Mane (Wolves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
57' Mateus Mane (Wolves) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
56' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
56' The referee can't ignore those comments and Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) sees a yellow card for bad language.
54' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Wolves players have a reason to celebrate!

54' 1 - 1 Santiago Bueno (Wolves) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
54' The referee awards a corner and Hugo Bueno (Wolves) goes over to take it.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves). The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
53' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes a direct free kick.
52' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.

51' A nice pass finds Adam Armstrong (Wolves) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Robin Roefs pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
49' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
48' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' Today's match ends for Pedro Lima who will be replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) has tested the patience of referee Paul Tierney and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Pedro Lima (Wolves) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
43' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
40' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the right post.
39' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Andre (Wolves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
36' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
33' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
32' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
32' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Mateus Mane (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.
30' Mateus Mane (Wolves) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to the bottom left corner, but Robin Roefs is alert and thwarts the effort.
29' The free kick will be taken by Mateus Mane (Wolves).
29' Paul Tierney interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Omar Alderete (Sunderland).
28' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Daniel Bentley.
27' The possession of the ball – 42:58.
27' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
26' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
24' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) is shown a harsh red card by the referee as his tackle warranted no more than a yellow card!

23' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Daniel Ballard (Sunderland), but referee Paul Tierney must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
22' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) commits a foul after dangerous play.
21' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

20' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Sunderland will take a throw-in.
17' 0 - 1 Gooal! Granit Xhaka takes over corner duties. Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 0:1.
17' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes the corner.
16' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
11' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
9' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Good movement by Toti (Wolves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
6' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
4' The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
3' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Sunderland will take the kick-off.
